description: Create the From name, business name and footer newsletters are sent with, on a newsletter domain. The organization's first identity becomes the default unless make_default is false; make_default true makes this one the default.

business_name.description: The sender's legal or trading name, shown in the footer.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key. If omitted, the MCP server generates one for POST tools.

make_default.description: true makes this the organization's default identity. false keeps it from being the default (an identity that was the default stops being it). Left out, the organization's first identity becomes the default and the default is otherwise unchanged.

name: shipmail_create_newsletter_sender_identity
title: Create Newsletter Sender Identity
